notes: Ruka 0.4.9: link preview cards in chat and agent replies. The first HTTP(S) URL in a message opens a card with title, description, site name and image. Metadata is fetched in the main process with a six-second timeout and a 512 KB cap; private, loopback, link-local and .internal/.local hosts are refused. Source HTML is never injected. Previews can be turned off in Settings -> Agent. Images still load from the remote host. 20/20 link checks pass.
